title: IRC adapter: a local IRC server (ircd) over mimid-agent's JMAP Chat
description: Lets any IRC client (irssi, WeeChat, HexChat, Textual, Adium's IRC) use MIMI rooms. Native front end (Mark 2026-11-19): a loopback-only IRC server built into mimid-agent, over a shared plaintext layer (mimid-agent-store) that the JMAP front end also uses, so one agent serves both. Design: docs/design/agent-frontends.md. Lessons from meshIRCd/tailircd: docs/irc-lessons.md. Never serve plaintext beyond the local machine (AGENTS.md).
notes:
Per decision mimid-gad8 (Mark 2026-11-17): this adapter may talk to mimid-agent over JMAP Chat or over its own binary client/server protocol, local only, still authenticated; the agent keeps the keys.
Mark 2026-11-19: native, not stacked on JMAP. Split the plaintext layer (event consumption/acknowledge, message history, contacts/nick identities, blobs and attachment retry, notices, consent/invite state) out of mimid-agent-jmap into a shared crate; JMAP and IRC become thin front ends over it, and one agent can serve both at once. Research of meshIRCd/tailircd lessons in progress.
Mark 2026-11-20 on docs/design/agent-frontends.md §6: PART leaves for real, JOIN of an unknown name hosts a room; no queries in v1; every nick <local>-<label>; no attachments in v1; invites/consent from IRC yes; no history in v1. Recorded in §7.
